long: The Settlers III is a real-time strategy and economy game in which players build settlements and complex production chains for one of three peoples: Romans, Egyptians, or Asians. Unlike earlier entries, settlers travel without fixed road networks, and players manage resource gathering, expansion, and military conquest. The Ultimate Collection bundles the base game with its expansions.
name: The Settlers III
